subject: Television & Streaming
title: Netflix's Unlikely Origin
description: Learn Netflix's Unlikely Origin in one minute.

hook.text: Reed Hastings returned a VHS copy of Apollo 13 late and paid a $40 fee. He started thinking about a better way.

buildup.text: In 1997, Hastings and Marc Randolph launched Netflix as a DVD-by-mail service. No late fees, ever.

discovery.text: The key innovation was the subscription model. For a flat monthly fee, you could rent unlimited DVDs.

twist.text: Blockbuster had the chance to buy Netflix for $50 million in 2000. They laughed at the offer.

climax.text: Blockbuster filed for bankruptcy in 2010. Netflix had 20 million subscribers and was about to change everything.

punchline.text: A $40 late fee destroyed a billion-dollar industry.

quiz.question: What inspired Reed Hastings to create Netflix?
options: A $40 late fee on a VHS rental
A desire to compete with HBO
